primaryChecks.text: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
primaryChecks.nextContext: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 3:1 はHebronを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;
primaryChecks.previousContext: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:
primaryChecks.nextContext: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 3:4 はHebronを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;
primaryChecks.previousContext: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
primaryChecks.nextContext: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 6:55 はHebronを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
primaryChecks.previousContext: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 6:57 はHebronを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
primaryChecks.nextContext: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. The LORD your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 11:1 はHebronを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. They anointed David king over Israel, according to the LORD’s word by Samuel.
primaryChecks.previousContext: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. The LORD your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”
primaryChecks.nextContext: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 11:3 はHebronを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the LORD’s word.
primaryChecks.previousContext: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 12:23 はHebronを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
primaryChecks.previousContext: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.
primaryChecks.nextContext: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 12:38 はHebronを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 29:27 はHebronを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king.
primaryChecks.nextContext: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: “Hebronites” is a Levitical kin-group/family designation (“according to their generations by fathers’ households”), not the town; explicitly excluded from this place profile.
